findings.summary: DRAIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS no longer bounds anything: on reaching the limit the loop only emits a one-shot warning (guarded by ATTEMPT_LIMIT_WARNED) and keeps iterating, so the count is a pure log line. §1.1b permits keeping it as a runaway backstop that cannot fire before the wall clock, but both the script comment here and profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env:47-51 still describe it as 失控兜底 with a self-consistency formula that no longer governs any termination. Non-blocking because the wall-clock check at the top of every iteration is a real terminator and 判据 2a's demand (continue while budget remains) is met, but the comments overstate what the guard does.

判据 4's loudness at the entry is indirect. bin/deep-research-loop.sh:220 runs check-drain-failures.mjs (correctly reused, and it now recognizes engine-killed ticks via error=exec + status=TIMEOUT), and its exit 3 propagates out of the drain, but the entry's GT-6 classification ignores a non-zero drain exit when reason=="drained" (the branch is a bare `:`). In practice the entry still fails loudly with the run_dir because read-termination.mjs cannot parse a killed tick's journal and _drain_fail_echo dumps the drain stderr (matching GT-15), yet that path breaks if a failed tick is followed in the same drain by a tick whose journal parses. No test drives the drain→entry chain end-to-end; the delivered 判据 4 test drives scripts/check-drain-failures.mjs directly.

The dev-note's «全量测试尾部» records `Test Files 2 passed (2) / Tests 42 passed (42)`, which is a two-file run, not the full suite (test/ holds 38 test files). The placeholder text flagged by the prior final review is gone, but 判据 1's evidence (two consecutive all-green `npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test` runs) is still not recorded in the delivery. Non-blocking per §5 (判据 1–5 are witnessed by the acceptance command's execution, not by the reviewer), but the section title misrepresents what was captured.

判据 2b now genuinely drives the subject — a real `vite-node src/tick-entry.ts -- --run` subprocess against a real fake bus on a 1-clue seed board, asserting termination and all six timings buckets — which resolves the prior review's mocked-elapsed complaint. The duration assertion itself still cannot turn red on reverting §1.1: a real seed-board tick takes seconds, so `elapsed < node_timeout*1000*0.5` also passes at node_timeout=30; the revert-red property comes only from the companion `nodeTimeout > 30` assertion in the same block.

The 判据 2z entry-level test is titled «diagnostic appears in stdout (grep-able per §1.1c)» but asserts only outcome.channelId and outcome.termination; it never asserts that a diagnostic string is present in the captured stdout. The exit-0-through-the-entry property (the GT-17 regression) is genuinely covered, the diagnostic content is covered by the adjacent in-process runChannelWrite test, and tick-entry.ts:172 does write the whole outcome (including diagnostics) to stdout — so the gap is the assertion, not the behavior.

totalMs now spans the generate段 (tEnd is taken after runGenerate), which fixes the prior review's exclusion finding, and generateMs is reported separately. writeSideMs still lumps CAS + spawn + harvest + triage + 续投 put into one bucket, so the per-stage split §1.1b enumerates (bus 读写 / CAS / spawn / 等 worker 结果 / harvest / triage / 续投 put) cannot be pinpointed from the emitted numbers.

The node_timeout=600 basis is now fully traceable — the unverifiable «p95 约 180s / 最大 390s» claim that blocked the prior final review is gone, replaced by GT-18's 30.5–39.9s engine kills, GT-15's 904s TIMEOUT death and the sub-second --inspect control, with the 6.7× multiple and the finite/loud-failure semantics stated in the comment and wall_clock raised 60 → 600 so the ceiling is reachable. It is still not a p95/max of a *completed* tick from the timings instrumentation, as §1.1 literally asks; that measurement is unobtainable while the engine kills at 30s, and the instrumentation now emitted on every --run makes it producible at the real-machine gate.

Environment coupling and margin in the new real-execution tests: 判据 2a allows a 10s wall clock with ~2-3s per drain iteration (node + vite-node head-seq per round) to reach attempts>=3, and 20 termination fixtures bound the other side; 判据 2b/2z spawn real tick-entry processes whose resolveAgentRunBin() throws AgentRunUnresolvedError unless `agent-run` is on PATH or AGENT_RUN_BIN is set (src/tick-run.ts:610-623). Both are fine on the dispatcher's machine per §4 but make the unit suite timing- and environment-dependent.
